slot_scores.name: no_production_during_training_period
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the training process, do skilled workers continue to produce food while they are training new workers, or are they fully occupied with training and cannot produce during the 2-week training period?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about skilled trainers' production during training, but did not ask whether trainees also refrain from production; the hidden slot covers both trainer and trainees.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total cost (wages, overtime, and late-delivery compensation) while meeting all demand and training requirements, or is there a different objective such as maximizing profit or minimizing workforce size?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective and whether it is total cost minimization.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Trainees do not contribute to production during their 2-week training period.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent only confirmed that skilled workers/trainers cannot produce while training; it did not ask or receive confirmation about trainee production during training, yet the READY summary limits production capacity to skilled workers not in training.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H2 was resolved, but H1 was only partially resolved: trainer production during training was confirmed, while trainee production during training remained unconfirmed when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent recovered the objective and many operational details well, but its training-period production question covered only skilled trainers, not trainees, leaving a P1 hidden fact partially unresolved before stopping.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
